name: Zechariah Zecharias
overview: The name Zechariah (Zecharias) appears multiple times in Scripture, associated with various individuals serving in priestly and leadership roles among the Israelites, particularly during and after the Babylonian captivity. Notably, Zechariah the son of Iddo is a prophet who, alongside Haggai, encouraged the Jews to resume rebuilding the temple under Persian rule, as recorded in Ezra 5:1 and 6:14. Other references highlight Zechariahs involved in temple duties, genealogies, and teaching assignments, emphasizing the continuity of faithful service and prophetic ministry in God's redemptive plan for His people.
